text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Summer week starting Monday 15 June 2026. Orange: AGV, the net import from the transmission system. Green: PV_Live's estimate of the solar generation of the distribution licence area with the same letter, which is embedded in the distribution network. Purple: their sum. The shares in the title are each group's solar divided by its AGV plus solar, summed over 1 September 2025 to 20 September 2026.'
